## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- FeedOptimizer — Chip Thinning
- increases feed when ae/D < 0.5 (chip thinning active)
- does not increase feed when ae/D >= 0.5
- respects maxFeedIncrease cap
- can be disabled via enableChipThinning=false
- FeedOptimizer — Corner Deceleration
